topic: Creating, managing, and migrating systemd-homed home directories for yubiOS (LUKS2 homes, YubiKey FIDO2/PKCS#11 enrollment, PAM wiring, suspend/resume key protection, portable homes)

subtopics.scope: The systemd-homed model: portable self-contained homes, the embedded JSON user record, NSS user synthesis, and the absence of /etc/passwd.
seed_queries: systemd-homed user record JSON NSS model
systemd-homed portable self-contained home directory design

subtopics.scope: Creating a LUKS2 home with FIDO2 unlock: homectl create flags, btrfs filesystem, recovery key ordering, and the FIDO2 client PIN plus user-presence requirements.
seed_queries: homectl create luks btrfs fido2-device options
systemd-homed recovery key FIDO2 client pin user presence

subtopics.scope: Enrolling FIDO2 on an existing home via homectl authenticate, and updating or replacing the recovery key on v259+.
seed_queries: homectl authenticate fido2-device enroll existing home
systemd-homed update recovery key v259

subtopics.scope: PKCS#11 / PIV unlocking with YubiKey slot 9c: token enumeration, auto selection, explicit PKCS#11 URIs, and the PIV advantage of token identity visible before auth.
seed_queries: systemd-homed pkcs11-token-uri YubiKey PIV
homectl YubiKey PIV slot 9c pkcs11 uri

subtopics.scope: Everyday home management: homectl inspect and list, JSON record inspection, passwd re-keying, resize, and auxiliary group membership updates.
seed_queries: homectl inspect list passwd resize commands
systemd-homed resize luks volume member-of groups

subtopics.scope: Moving a home between machines: public key exchange, copying the .home file, rescan via SIGUSR1 since v258, activation, and re-signing with the target host key.
seed_queries: systemd-homed migrate home directory another machine local.public
systemd-homed SIGUSR1 rescan homed v258 re-sign home record

subtopics.scope: PAM wiring for homed users: pam_systemd_home.so across auth, account, password, and session stacks, control-flag semantics, and suspend=1 key erasure on suspend.
seed_queries: pam_systemd_home.so PAM configuration stacks
pam_systemd_home suspend=1 forget key material suspend

subtopics.scope: homed.conf and drop-ins: DefaultStorage=luks and DefaultFileSystemType=btrfs defaults for yubiOS.
seed_queries: homed.conf DefaultStorage DefaultFileSystemType
systemd homed.conf.d drop-in configuration

subtopics.scope: Home areas since v258: secondary $HOME subdirectories, %area login syntax, run0 --area, and --default-area in the user record.
seed_queries: systemd v258 home areas homectl default-area
systemd home areas run0 area login username percent sign

subtopics.scope: Home record signing keys: local.private and local.public under /var/lib/systemd/home, trusted remote public keys, and v258+ D-Bus signing-key management.
seed_queries: systemd-homed local.private local.public signing keys
homectl list-signing-keys add-signing-key v258

subtopics.scope: The yubiOS deployment checklist: systemd-homed.service enabled in the image, homed.conf defaults, four-stack PAM wiring, suspend=1 on graphical sessions, and key backup discipline.
seed_queries: systemd-homed.service enable image deployment
systemd-homed backup local.private signing key

subtopics.scope: How the skill maps onto the yubiOS 10-primitive model: trust-chain anchor via YubiKey FIDO2 unlock, segmentation, declarative policy, least privilege, and the cycle 5 to 7 RSI audit trail.
seed_queries: yubiOS 10 primitive model trust chain systemd-homed
systemd-homed segmentation namespace least privilege
